_about: Owner edits applied from the File Tree explorer, keyed by [n]. Fields replace the parsed values. Knowledge (rules, purpose, details) goes into docs/file-tree.md and the topic docs; only page-only fields (examples, custom tables, file content) stay here.

47.1.1.summary: Single .env file holding all test credentials, grouped in sections with prefixed key names

example.body:
# Secrets: never commit credentials (D-023, D-027)
.secrets/
*.env
.env.*
!.env.example

# Claude Code local state: machine-specific, not shared (D-024)
**/.claude/settings.local.json
**/.claude/agent-memory-local/

# Cursor local state: same rule as .claude - only local files, the rest is committed
**/.cursor/settings.local.json
**/.cursor/state/
**/.cursor/cache/

# Runtime logs: written by agents at run time, not source
logs/**
!logs/**/
!logs/**/.gitkeep
agents/**/logs/**
!agents/**/logs/**/
!agents/**/logs/**/.gitkeep

# Runtime data: produced by agents/workers, not source
data/**
!data/**/
!data/**/.gitkeep
agents/**/data/**
!agents/**/data/**/
!agents/**/data/**/.gitkeep

# Dependency and build artifacts: regenerated, not source
node_modules/
dist/
build/
.venv/
venv/
__pycache__/
*.py[cod]
*.egg-info/
.pytest_cache/
.mypy_cache/

# OS and editor noise
.DS_Store
*.swp
.idea/
.vscode/
example.title: .gitignore

48.summary: ignores .secrets/, *.env, local Claude and Cursor state, runtime logs/ and data/ content (folders kept with .gitkeep), and common build/OS junk, each with a comment explaining why

1.content:
# Agent OS
An agentic trading system: workers collect data, agents at system / domain / strategy level decide and self-improve, and a UI lets the owner watch and approve.

- Start here: agents/system/.claude/docs/README.md
- Vision: agents/system/.claude/docs/vision.md
- File tree: project-IDE/ (the File Tree page and its data)
- Run: ./agents/system/start.sh   UI: cd trading-ui && npm run dev
